answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity in a slashable escrow: when evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, pairwise fault penalties scale as k(k−1)/2 = O(k²), not as isolated incidents. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, compounded by asymmetric depreciation of slashed collateral, so splitting keys cannot dilute risk. A lantern, comet, or mesa label changes neither evidence nor liability.
